reviews.title: Better privacy options would be nice
reviews.text:
I'd like to suggest adding customizable Story audience lists.

Currently, Instagram offers Close Friends or the option to hide Stories from individual accounts. However, there is no practical way to create multiple custom audiences.

It would be extremely useful to allow users to create and name their own audience lists (for example: friends, acquaintances, professional contacts etc) and share Stories with those audiences without displaying a special indicator that reveals they're on a particular list.

Close Friends feels limited. Sometimes users simply want more control over who sees specific content without making the audience selection obvious such as the green circle indicator. 

The hide story from option isn’t ideal when you have to manually select each person and you have hundreds to over one thousand followers.

Please consider adding discreet, customizable private audience lists. This would give users significantly more flexibility and control over their privacy.

reviews.title: いやはやバグにまみれたアプリです
reviews.text:
長くお世話になっておりますが、実に多くの巧妙なバグに悩まされてきました。
特に厳しいのが、投稿を作った後で、突然のバグにより初めからになるケースです。
例として、
●投稿が完成した後で、「下書き」に保存した所、再度開くと写真の編集内容がリセットされていた。
●写った顔を全て隠し、投稿写真を全て編集した後、「次へ」ボタンが隠れていて押せない。「編集内容を破棄しますか？」にYesしなければならない。
●位置情報が同表記で幾つも出てくる。違うもの(例えば漢字表記で日本ではなく中国の飲食店だったりする)を選択した場合、投稿後は「削除」しか無いので最悪作り直し。
などが挙げられます。
段々と必要な機能が使えなくなっていって、逆に「リール」など運営側の使わせたいものばかりが表示される。今の世の中の構造をよく表していますね。
大企業なので世界の人々はこのアプリを使わざるを得ない。しかし不便の訴えは巨大企業には届かず、矮小な1ユーザーは使いにくさに慣れるしかない。何か別のアプリが早くインスタを抑えて流行って欲しいですね。中国製以外で。
リール、タップで止まるように戻してください。

reviews.title: これもうBANわかんねぇな

何も悪い事してないのにアカウントBANされた。普通にInstagramを利用していただけなのに、突然アカウントを停止され、問い合わせても納得できる説明は得られず。挙げ句の果てには「マナーの真正性についてよく考えろ」という趣旨のメールまで届き、ファッ！？となりました。
具体的に何が問題だったのか説明してくれないと、こちらとしても改善のしようがないんですが、それは大丈夫なんですかね？ ユーザーには規約を守れと言う一方で、運営側の対応は不透明。これもうわかんねぇな。
異議申し立てをしても先行きが見えず、アカウントを取り戻せる保証もない。おっ、大丈夫か大丈夫か？と運営に問いかけたくなるレベルです。せめて停止理由くらいは明確に説明してほしいものです。
結局、アプリはアンインストールしました。いやもう十分堪能したよ……。SNSとしての機能は便利だっただけに、今回の対応は非常に残念です。運営にはユーザーへの説明責任について、†悔い改めて†ほしいですね。しょうがないね、これでは安心して利用できません。

reviews.title: Nuovo aggiornamento con annessi problemi 🤦🏻‍♀️
reviews.text:
Con il nuovo aggiornamento avete eliminato una funzione che per me era molto utile e pratica.
Prima, mentre guardavo un Reel, bastava tenere premuto il dito sullo schermo per bloccare immediatamente il video esattamente sul fotogramma desiderato. In questo modo potevo osservare un dettaglio, leggere una scritta o cogliere un particolare senza perdere nemmeno un istante. Bastava poi sollevare il dito per far ripartire il video.
Con il nuovo sistema, invece, bisogna toccare lo schermo per mettere in pausa e toccarlo nuovamente per riprendere la riproduzione. Ma non è affatto la stessa cosa! La pausa non permette di congelare il video esattamente nel momento desiderato con la stessa immediatezza del vecchio sistema.
E c’è un altro problema ancora più fastidioso: per far ripartire il video bisogna toccare nuovamente lo schermo e si rischia di mettere involontariamente LIKE a un Reel o a un contenuto, semplicemente perché si tocca nel punto sbagliato!
Perché eliminare una funzione così semplice, comoda e intelligente per introdurne una più scomoda e che aumenta persino il rischio di interazioni involontarie?
Vi chiedo di ripristinare la possibilità di tenere premuto lo schermo per congelare temporaneamente il video, oppure di permettere agli utenti di scegliere tra il vecchio e il nuovo sistema.
Non tutte le novità sono miglioramenti. A volte sarebbe meglio non cambiare ciò che funziona già perfettamente!

reviews.title: Searching tool while saving posts
reviews.text:
It’s honestly a disgrace that in 2026 Instagram still doesn’t offer a basic search function when saving posts.

If you want to save something to an existing collection, you have to manually scroll through all your folders until you find the one you’re looking for. There is no search bar, no quick way to locate a collection.

When you have dozens or even hundreds of saved collections, this becomes unnecessarily time-consuming and frustrating.

A search bar in the menu that appears when you tap “Save” should be a basic feature, not something users have to keep asking for.

This functionality would also be a very welcome improvement in other apps that use similar saving and collection systems.

reviews.title: Feedback About Repeated and Unfair Account Deactivation
reviews.text:
Dear Instagram Team,

Honestly, I am very disappointed and frustrated with this situation. How are we supposed to use your social media platform if our accounts keep getting suspended or deactivated unexpectedly?

Many users try their best to follow Instagram’s Community Guidelines, yet they still face account deactivation. Why does this happen? If users are following the rules, why are their accounts being disabled without a clear explanation?

Instagram is a platform where people connect with friends, share their creativity, build communities, and grow their businesses. We invest our time and effort into our accounts, so losing access unexpectedly is stressful and discouraging.

If an account violates a policy, please provide a clear explanation and a fair opportunity to appeal. If the system makes a mistake, users should have a reliable way to recover their accounts.

Please improve your account review system and stop deactivating genuine users’ accounts by mistake. We want to use Instagram safely and peacefully, but how can we trust the platform if this problem keeps happening?

I hope the Instagram team takes this feedback seriously and works to make the platform fairer and more reliable for everyone.

Thank you.
